briefs: docs/round10/track-w.md (read W0 first) and docs/round10/track-d0.md (the D0 registry plug-in checklist)
notes: Round 10 runs several tracks at once, each in its own worktree: D0 (shared mob registry), D (trial spawners, vaults, lodestones, breezes), W (darkness, vibrations, sculk, warden), E1 and E2 (known limits), F (Elden Ring boss), later M1-M3 (remaining mobs). Never bump minecraft_net::PROTOCOL, even where a brief says to: the release step bumps it once when messages changed; if a commit changes a ToClient/ToServer message or the codec, add a line under '## Protocol' in the track log. Insert new enum variants, match arms and list entries next to related ones, not at the end of lists, to keep merges small. Record decisions in the track log. RESTARTS: if this run was started again after a stop (the PC crashed on 2026-10-28 at 20:27 with six tracks building), the worktree may hold the current group's half-done work as uncommitted or staged changes: read `git status` and `git diff` (and `git diff --cached`) first, keep what is correct, finish the group and commit it; discard only what is broken. If cargo reports invalid or corrupt metadata, a truncated .rlib/.rmeta or a link error on a file that should exist, run `& .\scripts\cargo-slot.ps1 +target=<this track's target> clean -p <crate>` for that crate and build again. LOAD: builds now run at -j 4 per slot to keep the laptop cool; never start a second cargo command, the game, or any other long CPU-heavy process. EMITS_SOUNDS: D0 is merged now; its Family::emits_sounds hook drops a registered family's whole movement emission; confirm with a test that a silverfish (and the warden) still posts its step and swim game events (the w1 review asked for this), and record the check in the track log. SINCE w1: w1 is merged (81eaed3f) together with D (trial spawners, vaults, lodestones), D0 (the registry), E1, E2 (thrown things through EntityWorld::hit_boxes, which includes the registry families), F (Margit) and M1's first segment (rabbits, polar bears; M1 changed D0's texture test to check textures()[..2], a drawn family keeps that line), all in release 4 (protocol 9). Use D0's FamilyShow (flags and eight values) for the warden's pose and animation start ticks instead of a new MobShow field where it fits, and reuse the shared keyframes holder (keyframes::shared()) instead of a second AnimationLibrary. Track D's breezes (segment d2) are merged and in this branch now; they add registry hooks next to yours, keep yours in their own commits. RESUME 2026-11-02: this run resumes the segment after the week's stop on 2026-10-29 at 17:30. The repo moved to C:\Dev\Soscraft\mashup-crafting and the worktrees to C:\Dev\Soscraft\mc-wt\<track>; briefs, logs and specs in this branch may still name C:\Dev\mashup-crafting or C:\Dev\mc-wt: use the new paths. The first cargo command in this worktree rebuilds the workspace crates because their source path changed: slow but expected, not a corrupt build. Never amend, rebase or rewrite history: the 'Unfinished:' WIP commit stays in history and its group is finished in new commits with the brief's subjects. Do not merge minecraft-survival into the branch; the orchestrator merges at the end. SINCE THE STOP: minecraft-survival (8f7410e6) was merged into track-w before this run, so the branch now also holds D's d2 (breezes, fd93ce96), E1's e1b (23b449ef) and PROTOCOL 10 (e7c9a1c8), plus the other tracks' earlier merges. Nothing was built after that merge: the first group makes `check -p launcher` green and fixes any breakage the merge caused in a commit of its own. This segment's own net change is `git diff minecraft-survival...HEAD` (three dots) and its own commits are `git log --no-merges r10-w2-base..HEAD --not minecraft-survival`; the reviewer and the final verification use those (not `git diff r10-w2-base..HEAD`, which now includes other tracks' merged work) to find what to review and which crates were touched.

Tests, steps w14-w17, W4's kit.
